natural_language_instruction: Spawn in survival mode. Climb the full early-game tool progression: (1) collect wood and craft a wooden pickaxe, (2) mine cobblestone and craft a stone pickaxe, (3) find and mine raw iron, smelt it in a furnace, and craft an iron pickaxe. End with one iron_pickaxe in inventory. Avoid creepers and don't die in lava.
success_criteria: inventory contains (or contained at any point) >= 1 wooden_pickaxe
inventory contains (or contained at any point) >= 1 stone_pickaxe
